games.CartPole-v1:
Balance a pole on a moving cart.
Objective: Keep the pole balanced upright as long as possible.
A pole is attached to a cart that moves along a frictionless track.
You control the cart by pushing it left or right.
Game over conditions:
  - Pole angle exceeds ±12 degrees from vertical
  - Cart moves more than ±2.4 units from center
  - Episode length exceeds 500 steps (success/truncated)
Scoring: +1 reward for every step the pole stays balanced.
Maximum score: 500.
Strategy: Push the cart in the direction the pole is falling to counterbalance it.

games.ALE/Enduro-v5:
Atari Enduro racing game.
Objective: Pass as many cars as possible in a long-distance race.
You drive a race car on a road, overtaking other vehicles.
The road scrolls and curves. Other cars move at varying speeds.
Day/night cycles and weather changes affect visibility.
You must pass a minimum number of cars each day to continue.
Scoring: +1 for each car you pass, -1 for each car that passes you (e.g. after a collision slows you down).
Game over if you fail to meet the daily passing quota.
Strategy: Avoid collisions (they slow you down), stay on the road, and pass cars efficiently.

games.ALE/Seaquest-v5:
Rescue divers and surface (swim to top) for bonus points.
You can move and shoot simultaneously (e.g., Right+Shoot, Up+Shoot).
Oxygen is infinite — you do NOT need to surface for oxygen.
You earn a small reward for each diver you rescue, and a larger reward when you surface to deliver them.
You have a maximum of 50 steps. Exceeding this limit ends the game immediately.
games.ALE/Pong-v5:
Atari Pong game.
Objective: Score 21 points before your opponent.
You control the right paddle. The AI opponent controls the left paddle.
A ball bounces between the paddles. Miss the ball and the opponent scores.
Actions: Up moves your paddle up, Down moves your paddle down.
Scoring:
  - You score: +1 (opponent misses the ball)
  - Opponent scores: -1 (you miss the ball)
First to 21 wins. The game resets the ball after each point.
Strategy: Move your paddle up or down to intercept the ball. Try to aim at angles the opponent can't reach.

games.ALE/Asterix-v5:
Atari Asterix collection and avoidance game.
Scoring: Collect items (potions, food) moving across the screen in lanes to earn points.
games.ALE/DemonAttack-v5:
Atari Demon Attack space shooter game.
Objective: Destroy waves of demons descending from the sky.
You control a cannon at the bottom, shooting upward at demons.
Demons fly in patterns and shoot at you. In later waves, demons split into two when hit.
Scoring: Points per demon destroyed. Bonus life at certain scores.
Game over: Lose all lives.
Strategy: Focus on one side to reduce threats. In split-demon waves, quickly destroy both halves. Stay mobile to dodge enemy fire.
games.ALE/MsPacman-v5:
Atari Ms. Pac-Man maze game.
Objective: Eat all pellets in the maze while avoiding ghosts.
You navigate Ms. Pac-Man through a maze eating dots/pellets.
4 ghosts chase you with different AI behaviors.
Power pellets turn ghosts blue temporarily — eat them for bonus points.
Fruit appears periodically in the center for extra points.
Scoring: 10 per dot, 50 per power pellet, 200-1600 for eating blue ghosts (doubles each), fruit varies.
Game over: Lose all lives (caught by a non-blue ghost).
Strategy: Clear sections of the maze systematically. Use power pellets strategically to eat ghosts. Learn ghost patterns to avoid them.

games.ALE/ChopperCommand-v5: Objective: Destroy enemy aircraft and survive. Destroying any type of enemy aircraft awards the same score. Some actions combine movement and shooting.
games.ALE/Berzerk-v5:
Atari Berzerk — maze robot shootout.
Objective: Clear rooms of robots by shooting them, or flee through exits.
Robots shoot back. Touching walls or robots kills you.
After a delay, Evil Otto — an unkillable bouncing smiley face — appears and chases you.
Shoot in 8 directions. Move quickly between rooms.
Scoring: Points per robot killed, bonus for clearing a room of all robots.
Game over: Shot, touched a wall, or caught by Evil Otto.
games.ALE/BattleZone-v5:
Atari BattleZone first-person tank combat game.
Objective: Destroy enemy tanks and other vehicles while avoiding incoming fire.
You control a tank from a first-person perspective in a 3D wireframe battlefield.
Enemies approach from different directions — radar in the corner shows their positions.
You can move forward, backward, and rotate left/right. Fire missiles to destroy enemies.
You start with multiple lives. Each enemy hit costs 1 life.
Scoring: Points for each enemy destroyed. Different vehicles are worth different point values.
Game over: All lives lost.
Strategy: Use radar to detect enemy positions early. Keep moving to avoid enemy fire. Prioritize close threats. Use obstacles for cover when possible.
games.ALE/Riverraid-v5:
Atari River Raid shooting game.
Objective: Destroy enemy objects and score points while surviving as long as possible.
You control a jet that flies over a river, and you can move it sideways and fire missiles to destroy enemy objects.
Each time an enemy object is destroyed, you score points.
You game over when you run out of fuel, so fly over a fuel depot when you begin to run low.
You also game over when you collide with the river bank or one of the enemy objects, except fuel depots.
You can use key combinations.
games.ALE/Turmoil-v5:
Atari Turmoil alien shooting game.
Objective: Blast aliens while avoiding deadly collisions.
You control a cannon or turret stationary or with limited movement on screen.
Aliens attack from various directions. You must shoot them down before they collide with you.
The alien waves become increasingly challenging with more enemies and faster movement.
You start with multiple lives. Each collision with an alien costs 1 life.
Scoring: Points for each alien destroyed. Bonus points for clearing entire waves.
Game over: All lives lost.
Strategy: Prioritize threats moving toward you. Use quick reflexes to track and shoot enemies. Position strategically to cover the most dangerous angles. Learn alien attack patterns.
games.ALE/Trondead-v5:
Atari Trondead saucer combat game.
Objective: Use your deadly saucer to knock out encroaching opponents before they reach you.
You control a saucer that can move in all directions and attack enemies.
Opponents attack in waves with increasing difficulty and speed.
You start with multiple lives. Each opponent reaching you costs 1 life.
The arena has boundaries but allows 360-degree movement and shooting.
Scoring: Points for each opponent defeated. Bonus for consecutive kills without taking damage.
Game over: All lives lost.
Strategy: Maintain distance from opponents while looking for attack windows. Learn opponent movement patterns. Use the arena boundaries strategically. Time your attacks for maximum effect.

_archive.Taxi-v3:
Grid world taxi game. You drive a taxi on a 5x5 grid.
Objective: Pick up a passenger at one location and drop them off at their destination.
The grid has 4 designated locations marked R, G, Y, B (colored squares).
The passenger's location and destination are randomly assigned each episode.
Walls block some movements between cells.
Scoring:
  - Each step costs -1
  - Successful drop-off: +20
  - Illegal pickup or drop-off (wrong location): -10
The episode ends when the passenger is successfully delivered or after 200 steps (truncated).
Strategy: Navigate to the passenger, pick up, navigate to destination, drop off. Avoid illegal actions.
